claims.text: KPL’s commemoration describes Anouvong’s Vientiane rule and revolt. ICOMOS distinguishes Luang Prabang’s royal history and Siamese influence from Vientiane’s destruction by Siamese forces. The 1893 English treaty translation separately prescribes left-bank renunciation and restricted local policing. Neither that instrument nor a modern national label turns these into one undivided polity, identical offices or popular consent.
